info.title: TrueLift
info.description: Forecast, target and measure restaurant-funded offers by the extra orders and profit they create. **Hooks** are the calls Zomato's offer flow would make; **demo** routes run the simulated market behind the prototype. Every figure is simulated.

post.summary: Renew an offer whose approval period ended: a new OTP, shown what was measured
post.description:
The owner renews on evidence, not on a forecast: the new offer carries what the last period
measured (extra orders, extra profit, range, verdict) and the consent record stores it. The
same customers stay in the control group, so the measurement carries on (audit A09 D3).

BrandPackMeasurement.title: BrandPackMeasurement
BrandPackMeasurement.description: The Brand Pack reward measured on its own: regulars who got it against regulars held out.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: True if every record in the ledger still matches its hash chain

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.description: Position and SHA-256 hash in the append-only consent ledger

discount.title: Discount
discount.description: Rupees off the order; 0 means no discount

min_order.title: Min Order
min_order.description: Offer applies only to bills of at least this; 0 = none

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Who may see it: everyone, new to the restaurant, stopped ordering (4+ weeks), or chosen by TrueLift

reward.title: Reward
reward.description: Brand Pack reward per order for regulars (3+ orders in 4 weeks)

zomato_share.title: Zomato Share
zomato_share.description: Share of the discount Zomato funds for customers new to Zomato

pct.title: Pct
pct.description: Percentage offer: this share of the bill off, up to `discount` rupees (the cap); 0 means a flat offer of `discount` rupees

DesignIn.title: DesignIn
DesignIn.description: An offer as the owner sets it up on the create screen.

pct_offers.title: Pct Offers
pct_offers.description: Percentage offers: one percentage per cap (the depths above)

DesignOptions.title: DesignOptions

forecast_at_approval.title: Forecast At Approval
